nodes.label: "Gemma 4 Integration" (README-claimed Grounded Generative AI)
nodes.rationale: README markets the grounded generative AI feature as 'Gemma 4 integration', but BACKEND_DOCUMENTATION.md and both requirements.txt files show the actual production model is the Google GenAI Gemini API (google-genai package) grounded by a local disease knowledge base, not a Gemma model. No Gemma/transformers/gguf dependency appears anywhere in requirements.txt or Backend/requirements.txt. This is a documentation/naming discrepancy directly relevant to reconciling the vet_ai_gemma4 Kaggle notebook (which implies an actual Gemma model) with the documented architecture (which uses Gemini via API, not a locally-run or fine-tuned Gemma model).

nodes.label: Collaboration Guide & Git Workflow
nodes.rationale: Direct pushes to main are disallowed; feature branches and local test runs are required before opening a PR, to keep code quality consistent in a collaborative student/open project.

nodes.label: Keyword-Matching Grounding Step
nodes.rationale: Before calling Gemini, backend combines text+audio-transcript input and does case-insensitive substring matching against symptoms in disease_knowledge_base.json (optionally filtered by animal_type), appending any matches to the prompt as a reliable info-source block. This grounds the generated answer in vetted local data and reduces hallucination; if nothing matches, the model falls back to general reasoning but is explicitly instructed to state the advice is a general assessment, not a confirmed diagnosis.

nodes.label: Salted Scrypt Password Hashing
nodes.rationale: Passwords are hashed with salted scrypt rather than stored in plaintext or with a weaker hash, so the database never stores recoverable credentials.

nodes.label: SHA-256 Session Token Hashing + TTL Expiry
nodes.rationale: Only a SHA-256 hash of the bearer token is stored (never the plaintext token); MongoDB's TTL index on expires_at automatically removes expired sessions in the background, and expired sessions are also rejected/removed on encounter, limiting exposure if the DB is ever read.
nodes.norm_label: sha-256 session token hashing + ttl expiry

nodes.label: Missing CORS Configuration
nodes.rationale: The application currently has no CORS configuration; documented explicitly as a deployment gap because a browser client hosted on a different origin will need an explicit CORS policy before it can call the API.

nodes.label: Bengali-First Design Principle
nodes.rationale: Interface is intentionally Bengali-first (labels, actions, feedback, errors) because the target users are everyday livestock owners and pet caregivers in Bangladesh who need plain-language access without English literacy barriers.

nodes.label: AI-Is-Not-A-Vet Safety Reminder
nodes.rationale: Product presents AI guidance as preliminary information, not a clinical diagnosis, and persistently reminds users to contact a nearby veterinarian, especially for emergencies or severe symptoms, because the AI may be incorrect.

nodes.label: Session-Only Sign-in Privacy Behaviour
nodes.rationale: Sign-in state is kept only for the active browser session and saved responses are tied to the signed-in account and never shown to other users; on expiry the app clears local signed-in state before showing protected content, to keep private health-history data from leaking to other device users.
